evidence.observation: Tube pressure rose steadily from 2.998 to 3.212 Torr during growth (t=2520-2880) while Ar flow held at ~100 sccm.
Exhaust O2 rose from ~6-9 ppm to 24.3 ppm over the same period; oxygen coming in alongside the pressure rise fits air leaking in, not a blocked exhaust.
MFC reading 99.9-101.6 sccm, matching setpoint, so a flow excess does not explain the pressure rise.
Thermocouple at 750.0 °C after a normal overshoot; heater power 45%, plausible.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-rate check (isolate the tube and watch the pressure rise) or a leak test with a helium or pressure sniffer at the flanges would confirm a seal leak. Reference ranges for P and O2 during growth would show how large the deviation is.
